title: Data exfiltration over HTTP POST
hypothesis: Large volumes of internal data leaving over HTTP/S.
queries: DeviceNetworkEvents | where Direction == 'Outbound' | where RemoteUrl startswith 'http' | where InitiatingProcessFileName != 'browser' | where ActionType == 'ConnectionSuccess' | summarize bytes=count() by RemoteUrl | where bytes > 1000
rationale: Bulk POST volume signal (needs byte counts from proxy).
